metadata.question: Did nighttime lights in Obolon, Ukraine, decrease in May 2022 compared to March 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Dataset: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG (fallback: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG)
- Dates: March 1–31, 2022; May 1–31, 2022
- Location: Obolon district, Kyiv (explicit bounding polygon around Obolon)

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use monthly cloud-free composite; still mask to pixels with cf_cvg > 0 and avg_rad within [0, 1000] to avoid invalids/outliers.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallback -> C1
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 -> C2
- If mean radiance is null/NaN -> C3
- Otherwise compare means with small tolerance to avoid noise; decide A (Yes) if May < March, else B (No)
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfo = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
  const fmt = (x, d=3) => (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x) ? String(x) : Number(x).toFixed(d));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const obolon = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[30.44, 50.55], [30.54, 50.55], [30.54, 50.48], [30.44, 50.48], [30.44, 50.55]]
  ]);
  const marStart = '2022-03-01', marEnd = '2022-03-31';
  const mayStart = '2022-05-01', mayEnd = '2022-05-31';

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
  const primaryId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG';
  const fallbackId = 'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG';

  function monthlyImage(dsId, start, end) {
    const col = ee.ImageCollection(dsId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(obolon);
    return col.sort('system:index').first();
  }

  async function getMonthImage(start, end) {
    let dsUsed = primaryId;
    let img = monthlyImage(primaryId, start, end);
    let sz = await getInfo(ee.ImageCollection(primaryId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(obolon).size());
    if (sz === 0) {
      dsUsed = fallbackId;
      img = monthlyImage(fallbackId, start, end);
      sz = await getInfo(ee.ImageCollection(fallbackId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(obolon).size());
      if (sz === 0) return {img: null, dataset: null, size: 0};
    }
    return {img, dataset: dsUsed, size: sz};
  }

  try {
    const mar = await getMonthImage(marStart, marEnd);
    const may = await getMonthImage(mayStart, mayEnd);

    if (mar.size === 0 || may.size === 0) {
      console.log(`Mar Images: ${mar.size}`);
      console.log(`May Images: ${may.size}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Ensure same dataset if possible; for transparency print both
    console.log(`Datasets -> Mar: ${mar.dataset}, May: ${may.dataset}`);

    // 3. Processing and pixel counts
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;
    const totPix = await getInfo(
      ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: obolon,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('one')
    );

    async function summarize(img, label) {
      const cf = img.select('cf_cvg');
      const rad = img.select('avg_rad');
      const maskedRad = rad.updateMask(cf.gt(0)).updateMask(rad.gte(0)).updateMask(rad.lte(1000));

      const radStats = await getInfo(maskedRad.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
        geometry: obolon,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }));
      const cfMean = await getInfo(cf.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: obolon,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('cf_cvg'));

      const mean = radStats ? radStats['avg_rad_mean'] : null;
      const count = radStats ? radStats['avg_rad_count'] : 0;
      const covPct = (totPix && totPix > 0) ? (100 * (count || 0) / totPix) : null;

      console.log(`${label} Images: 1; ValidPix: ${count}/${totPix} (${fmt(covPct,1)}%); avg_rad: ${fmt(mean,3)}; cf_mean: ${fmt(cfMean,3)}`);
      return {mean, count};
    }

    const marStats = await summarize(mar.img, 'Mar-2022');
    const mayStats = await summarize(may.img, 'May-2022');

    // 4. Validation
    if ((marStats.count || 0) === 0 || (mayStats.count || 0) === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    const marMean = marStats.mean;
    const mayMean = mayStats.mean;

    if (marMean === null || mayMean === null || isNaN(marMean) || isNaN(mayMean)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Decision
    const absThresh = 0.1;
    const relThresh = 0.02 * marMean;
    const thresh = Math.max(absThresh, relThresh);
    const diff = mayMean - marMean;
    const rel = (diff / marMean) * 100.0;

    console.log(`Delta (May - Mar): ${fmt(diff,3)} (${fmt(rel,2)}%), threshold: ${fmt(thresh,3)}`);
    const decreased = (mayMean < marMean - thresh);

    console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
